title: The admin Pulse Stream to decisions/0172: one row per thing, rows open in place, the row's icons
why: Jason, 2026-11-18: "if communications is done why does my inbox look the same?" The admin Pulse Stream now follows 0172 like the member's: a case that bundled many things (the engine's "needs a person", Site health's findings) shows one row per thing from its sender, each acting through the same case; each row opens in place under itself with what happened, its stepper, its steps' own buttons (Mark shipped, Answer it, Fixed or fine) acting there, the latest notes and a note box; Work on it carries it to the drawer with the tool beside it. Each row has the seven icons (read or unread, pass it on, pin, escalate, file or Archive, add to: Follow up, importance, tags; open) and the views Inbox, Pinned, Follow up, Archived and folders, the person's own (/user/api/marks.php). The table's look (From, Severity, Subject, Received) is kept. Pulse.php is unchanged (the Control Board session's 3b changes it).
proposals: decisions/0172 (Pulse: one row is one thing; the row's icons; the message)
